# Tracking Data Availability by Season

**Generated by:** `src/data_fetch/probe_tracking_availability.py`
**Purpose:** Determine BKE tier for each season before committing to a backfill strategy.

---

## Root Cause Discovery (2026-05-28)

The original probe (and fetcher) sent only 6 minimal params to `leaguedashptstats`.
The NBA API now requires a full ~30-param query string (all optional filter fields present,
even if set to `""` or `0`). Sending minimal params causes **HTTP 500** on all seasons —
including 2022-23 which was known to have data. This was misread as "data not available."

**All seasons from 2017-18 onward have full tracking data.** The previous `rapm_only`
classification for 2017-18 through 2021-22 was wrong — it reflected a parameter bug,
not absent data.

Fix applied:
- `src/data_fetch/fetch_tracking_data.py`: added `_PTSTATS_DEFAULTS` constant, merged into
  `fetch_tracking()` params. Also added back `"Defense"` measure type (was removed in an
  older refactor; still used by `compute_defensive_archetypes_v2.py`).
- `src/data_fetch/probe_tracking_availability.py`: same defaults applied to all ptstats probes.
- `scripts/backfill_tracking_missing.py`: targeted backfill for 6 seasons × 8 measures.

---

## BKE Tier Definitions

| Tier | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `full` | All 9 BKE dimensions available (all tracking + synergy endpoints return data) |
| `reduced` | BKE without PCValue surplus (partial tracking — drives+at-rim but no playtype) |
| `rapm_only` | No tracking data — RAPM backbone score only |
| `covid` | Season flagged as COVID-disrupted (always rapm_only, reduced decay weight) |

## Missing Measures (before backfill)

All 6 affected seasons were missing the same 8 `leaguedashptstats` measures:
- `tracking_Drives`
- `tracking_Defense`  ← was removed from TRACKING_MEASURES; restored
- `tracking_PullUpShot`
- `tracking_Passing`
- `tracking_Possessions`
- `tracking_Rebounding`
- `tracking_Efficiency`
- `tracking_SpeedDistance`

Additionally, 2025-26 was missing `defense_3Pointers` and `defense_LessThan6Ft`
(these use `leaguedashptdefend` which works with minimal params; likely a transient
failure when the pipeline originally ran).
